text: Luis has a second interview at the logistics firm on Thursday. He sounded far more relaxed about it than last time.
Remind me to ask Deepa how the flat viewing in Leeds went. It was this morning and she was hoping to put an offer in.

Theo and his partner Ann are moving to Glasgow on June 3rd. Their landlord finally agreed to let them out of the lease early. Ann has already found a job at a school in the West End, but Theo is still applying for things and has an interview over video next Monday. He admitted he's a bit nervous about moving without work lined up.
Coffee with Olga. Her brother Nikolai has just been offered a junior developer role, and he starts on May 14. She's thrilled for him.
Need to book the van for the move. Saturday the 21st, 8am pickup, and I still have to collect boxes from the garden centre.

Kavya called. Her mum is coming over from Pune next Tuesday and staying for a month, so Kavya is frantically clearing out the spare room. She mentioned her mum loves orchids, which might be worth remembering.
Patrick's interview with the council got pushed back to 5/22. He's nervous because it's a panel of four.
Layla said the viewing on Friday is off. The landlord let the flat to someone else before she could even see it.
Don't forget to text Ciara good luck before her assessment day tomorrow.
Keisha and Rin are finally getting a dog! A rescue greyhound called Biscuit, arriving this weekend.

Ayo told me his sister Khadija is applying for a master's in Edinburgh. She has to submit everything by December 1st, and he thinks she's underestimating how long the personal statement will take. Their dad is pushing for her to stay in London instead.
Abdi is vegetarian, not vegan. Note for the housewarming.
Mia's grandad had a fall last week and is in hospital. She's going up to see him on Sunday. I should check in with her on Monday.

Ioana Popescu, Alfie's old flatmate, is moving to Lisbon in a fortnight. Alfie seemed a bit down about it. They lived together for six years, and he's now got to find someone new for her room before July 1st or cover the rent himself. He asked if I'd keep an ear out.
Must call Sofia about the reference letter. She asked if I could have it to her by Wednesday.
Aisha got the job! She starts at the architecture practice on August 4th. Send her flowers.
Efua mentioned she's been collecting vintage film cameras for years. She has about thirty now.

Spoke to Jen after the open house. She and her husband loved the second place but think the commute would be too much for him. They're going back for another look next Saturday with her parents, who are helping with the deposit. I should ask her on Sunday what they decided.
Abigail is struggling with the job hunt. Six applications, no replies, and her redundancy pay runs out at the end of the month.
Lindiwe's daughter graduates on July 9th. Lindiwe is flying to Cape Town for it the week before.
Samir said Kieran's leaving do has been cancelled because half the team is off sick. They'll rearrange in the new year.

Hugo is starting a new job at a bank in Frankfurt in September, so he and Phoebe are house hunting over there. She's not sure about leaving her own job yet. They're flying out on the 18th for a week of viewings, and her mum is looking after their cat Mochi while they're away. Hugo says the German paperwork alone is a full-time job.
I'm viewing the two-bed on Elm Road at 6 tomorrow, then the one by the station on Thursday.
Remind me to ask Eli whether he heard back from the museum. The interview was on Monday and they said they'd call within a week.
Anjali and Deepa are hosting a joint birthday dinner on March 8th. Anjali hinted that a cookbook would go down well.
Luis's cat Pepper had her teeth out yesterday. He said she's eating again, which is a relief.

Patrick Hughes from the recruitment agency rang about the operations manager role. First stage is a video call on Tuesday, 10am. I need to prepare a short presentation on supply chain risk. If that goes well, the second stage is in person at their Birmingham office, probably the week of the 15th. Remind me to update my CV tonight before I forget.

Theo says his mum is selling the family house in Cork. She's moving into a smaller place near his aunt by the end of October. He's helping her sort through the attic this weekend and is dreading it. His dad died two years ago and most of his things are still up there. I should give Theo a ring on Monday to see how it went.
Olga's partner Keisha just passed her driving test on the third attempt. Need to send a congrats message.
Phoebe's sister Ciara is doing a half marathon on April 27th. Phoebe says she's barely trained.
Grocery run, then return the library books. Pay the council tax before Friday.
Kieran mentioned he hates open-plan offices, which is why he turned down the agency job last month.
Nikolai, or Niko as everyone calls him, has a final round at a games studio on 6/10. He's been preparing for weeks and seems pretty confident.
Mia and her boyfriend Hugo broke up. The trip to Rome they had booked for next month is cancelled. She seemed okay but quiet.
Should message Rin next week to see how the new flat is working out. They moved in on Saturday and the boiler was already making noises.
Ann's son has an interview for a sixth form college on Wednesday afternoon. She's more anxious than he is.
Abdi Ibrahim, the guy from the climbing gym, is relocating to Bristol for work. He asked if I knew anyone renting out a room there.

Kavya's dad turns seventy on November 2nd. Big family party in Leicester the Saturday after. Remind me to get a card and something small. Kavya said he's into birdwatching and has been eyeing a new pair of binoculars, though her brother might already be getting those. Check with her on Friday before I order anything.
Sofia and Samir are expecting their second baby in January. Their eldest, Leo, is very excited about being a big brother.

Long call with Layla tonight. Her housemate is moving out in two weeks, so she's either finding a replacement or giving notice herself. She's also got an interview at the hospital trust on Friday, which would mean commuting to Reading. Her boyfriend Kieran thinks she should take it if offered, but she's worried about the hours. I promised I'd help her look at rooms on Sunday. Need to ring her Thursday night to wish her luck.
Efua had her appraisal yesterday and has been put forward for promotion. Decision by the end of the quarter.
Jen's dog Toffee went missing this morning. She's put posters up around the park. Text her tonight to see if there's any news.
Alfie is applying for teacher training. He loves working with kids and has volunteered at a youth club for three years.
Note to self: renew the passport before the Lisbon trip in May. I keep putting it off.
Aisha's brother Ayo moves into his first flat on Saturday. She and their mum are driving the van down from Manchester. He's paying for pizza in exchange.
Need to email Khadija the link to that letting agent in Bristol. She's looking for a one-bed near the university.

Eli has a phone interview with the charity on Monday and a second one with the publisher the Thursday after. On top of that his lease ends on the 30th, so it's a stressful couple of weeks for him. He said he'd let me know how both go.
Lindiwe told me she's allergic to nuts. Worth remembering for the dinner next week.
Deepa got the flat! Contracts are being signed on May 2nd and she moves on the 16th. Her parents are coming down to help, and her brother Samir has offered his car for the smaller bits.
Dr Fischer is retiring at the end of term, according to Abigail. There's a collection going round the department.
Don't forget to ask Hugo how his visa appointment went. It was Tuesday.
Ioana's twins start nursery on September 8th. She's worried they'll struggle to settle.
Booked the removal company for June 12th. Final meter readings on the morning of the move.
Patrick was turned down for the head of department role. He took it better than I expected. Maybe take him out for a drink next week.
Uncle Theo's knee surgery is on Friday. Mum is driving him in, and she said Auntie Olga will stay with him over the weekend.
Phoebe told me she's thinking of retraining as a nurse. She's been looking at courses starting next autumn.
Rin's wedding is on 9/14 in Kyoto. She and her fiancée are hoping most people can make it out there. Start looking at flights soon.
Keisha has been really homesick since moving to Toronto in March. Her mum is visiting her over Christmas, which should help. I must call her this weekend.
Anjali says her new manager is great and she's much happier at work now.

Saw Luis and his wife at the market. They're thinking about moving to Valencia next spring, once the kids finish the school year. He's already learning Spanish on his commute and she's been looking at schools near the old town. No firm date yet, but they're going out in a fortnight to view a few places. I should ask him about it when they're back.
